cost_model.applies_to: both legs of the round trip, on notional
cost_model.note: Applied by tools/forward_tracker.py sync. Ledger pnl is NET; pnl_gross keeps the raw move. Same basis as the vwap backtest.

FABER10_SPY.thesis: 10M SMA overlay: risk reduction, not alpha

vwap-reversion-scout.thesis: Price >2% below its 20d VWAP with RSI<40 and the close in the upper half of the day's range: institutional cost-basis reversion on liquid US names. Exit on TP/SL or a 168h (7-day) time stop.

baseline.status: PRIOR ONLY — not evidence that survives forward testing

vwap-reversion-scout.kill_rule: slow clock (median hold >5d): 180d & n>=8 & PF<1.00 -> KILL; 365d & n>=20 & PF<1.05 -> KILL; breaker n>=10 & PF<0.75 -> KILL. PROMOTE requires 365d, n>=20, PF>=1.15 and boot5(PF)>1.00.

rs-breakout-scout.thesis: Relative-strength breakout on liquid US names: enter when strength is new against the market rather than absolute momentum. Registered because the vwap clock alone needs ~3 years to reach its promotion sample.

prior.status: IN-SAMPLE SELECTION ONLY — best clustered t of the 127 strategy/class pairs screened. Fails the Bonferroni bar (|t| >= 3.54 at k=127) and must not be described as a validated edge. The forward test is the only admissible evidence.

measurement_design.primary: One-sided test that the mean excess_pp per (entry_day, exit_day) window is > 0, clustered so batch closes count once and one exit date cannot masquerade as many trades.
measurement_design.derivation: n = ((z_0.975 + z_0.80) * sd / mean)^2 = ((1.96 + 0.84) * 4.122 / 1.084)^2 = 152 windows. At the observed 74 windows/yr that is ~2.0 years, the soonest a fixed-sample test can decide without inflating alpha.
measurement_design.interim_rule: Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming: boundary c_k = C/sqrt(t_k), C solved through the exact joint-normal recursion so total one-sided alpha = 0.05. IMPLEMENTED in tools/forward_tracker.py (of_boundaries, interim_verdict).
measurement_design.cost_basis: 6 bps per side on both legs, applied by tools/forward_tracker.py sync; verdicts read NET pnl.

rs-breakout-scout.kill_rule: KILL at any look with n>=20 windows if mean excess < 0 AND boot5(PF) < 1.00; KILL at n>=50 if mean excess < +0.25pp (below the cost-adjusted prior). PROMOTE requires crossing the pre-computed OF boundary at a scheduled look 4.21 / 2.98 / 2.11 / 1.71 with the endpoint mean > 0 — early promotion is allowed but demands roughly twice the final evidence.

killed_in_backtest.RSI2_SPY: 0.21% CAGR, SR -0.64, DSR 0.00, negative at 2x costs
killed_in_backtest.vol-contraction-scout_forward: n=57 windows, +0.605pp, t +0.89 — screened and NOT registered: weakest significant-ish candidate, would consume the same clock as rs-breakout-scout
killed_in_backtest.luxalgo_confluence: 1,173 picks but -0.032pp at t -1.89: the highest-frequency strategy in the book is a cost sink, which is why the clock-fill problem cannot be solved by picking a busier strategy
